implementation: Real VLM agent when photos and key exist; otherwise a labelled CSV replay for sample units. Real path: one batched OpenAI-compatible vision call per unit (reference_* and returned_* photos), then deterministic Round 2 rules grade condition on Amazon's published scale and pick a disposition. The real model path has only been tested with a fake model, NOT against a live API. Photos but no key or a model error: a pending record. No photos: a replay of the sample CSV row (model.name csv-replay, calls 0) that copies the operator's disposition and is not this agent's judgment.
notes: Python, in-process. Round 2 code is in core/rtn/ (import paths only changed). Real path needs VLM_API_KEY and the packages openai, pydantic-settings, tenacity, python-dotenv (imported lazily; see INTEGRATION-NOTES.md). Condition-to-verdict mapping is provisional, pending Pod confirmation (F-11).
